FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Everard stands tall, its stone walls bearing the weight of centuries. But amidst the grandeur, a subtle shift is underway. The once-majestic halls now echo with the soft hum of synthesizers and the gentle whir of tape loops.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Everard, a stout man with a bushy beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his courtiers. But instead of the traditional regalia, they wear pastel-colored jumpsuits and oversized sunglasses.

KING EVERARD
(to his courtiers)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our empire. One that blends the grandeur of our past with the... (he consults a worn leather book)...futurism of the East.

COURTIER 1
(nervously)
But, Your Majesty, what of our traditional heraldry? Our coats of arms, our banners?

KING EVERARD
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... last season. We must adapt, my friends. We must become... (he searches for the right word)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle's gardens, once a lush oasis, are now transformed into a surreal landscape of distorted, VHS-style glitches. Water features bubble and distort, like a malfunctioning video game.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The courtiers, now dressed in their pastel jumpsuits, gather around the king as he reveals his latest decree.

KING EVERARD
(to his courtiers)
From this day forward, our empire shall be known as... (dramatic pause)...Vaporia.

COURTIER 2
(skeptically)
But, Your Majesty, what of our trade agreements? Our alliances with neighboring kingdoms?

KING EVERARD
(waving his hand again)
Pfft, those are so... linear. We must think outside the box, my friends. We must become... (he consults his book once more)...postmodern.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE WALLS - DAY

The castle walls, once a sturdy defense, now feature a dizzying array of neon lights and distorted, VHS-style glitches. The sound of distant, warped synthesizers echoes through the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The courtiers, now fully embracing the vaporwave aesthetic, gather around the king as he declares his latest decree.

KING EVERARD
(to his courtiers)
From this day forward, our empire shall be known as... (dramatic pause)...Vaporia. And we shall rule with an iron fist... of nostalgia.

FADE TO BLACK.
